title: Stage-3 REQ-1: the @bv tag, parse-gated (thermite-syntax foundation)
description: The language's FIRST clause-level annotation. thermite-syntax parses ens@bvN / inv@bvN / @bvN(nowrap) for N∈{8,16,32,64}, and lemma items accept it, ONLY when the bv plumbing is compiled in. Clause (src/ast.rs:596, today {expr,text,span}) grows bv: Option<BvTag> where BvTag{width:BvWidth, nowrap:bool}; parse_contract (src/parser.rs:1376, the req→ens→fx ordered dispatch) grows a tag step guarded by cfg!(feature="bv"); thermite-syntax/Cargo.toml gains its first [features] entry (bv). Stage-1/2 added clause CONTENT as expression-level constructs (Expr::Quantifier, parser.rs:2600) — the tag is genuinely new mechanism. AC-1: build with bv off rejects ens@bv64 with a structured parse error (build-flag test compiles the crate twice); build with bv on parses all 4 widths + nowrap with AST round-trip over Clause.bv. This is R-BV-1, the G3 structural lock. Doc: .design/stage3-bv-reconstruction.md REQ-1. Gate: G3.
